title: satureja douglasii
intro: Satureja douglasii, commonly known as Mountain savory, is a perennial herb native to the western United States and Mexico. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, colds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mountain savory include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Satureja douglasii include phenolic compounds, essential oils, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its aromatic and therapeutic effects.
